items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only reacts with 'Wow!' to the interviewer's statement that they taped Gil Evans. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Jimmy McPartland and Gil Evans in the text.

ctx.x: Whereas to me, the gospel and spirituals, that was it. Basically it.

It's very interesting to hear you say that because when Gil was here the other day, Gil Evans, I was taping him, he was looking through my record collection and he saw one that I had of Sister Rosetta Thorpe and another was of Little Richard which he vowed to take home to tape. (LAUGHTER).
